fullText.simplified:
第2章、烧粮草

    马上就要打仗了，周瑜经常到江边来看一看，每次看完他都不说话。鲁肃问他在想什么，他也不说话。鲁肃就来问诸葛亮，诸葛亮笑着说：“放心吧，周将军心里有安排，鲁大人不用担心。”
    诸葛亮说这样的话，让人觉得他好像很了解周瑜，就像他是周瑜的老朋友。周瑜听到这些话，有点儿高兴，也有点儿不高兴。高兴的是很少有人这么了解自己，不高兴的是他不希望自己的计划被人看出来，更不希望这个人就是诸葛亮。因为诸葛亮是刘备的人，不但不能做朋友，而且还不能太聪明。
    周瑜请诸葛亮来家里喝茶。喝茶的时候，他对诸葛亮说：“曹操的军队每天都要吃饭，战马每天都要吃草。如果没有粮和草，曹操就不能打仗了，所以我想请你带兵去烧曹操的粮草，你能做到吗？”
    诸葛亮笑着说：“没问题。”他喝了口茶，就回去准备了。
    鲁肃听说了，马上来问周瑜：“你真的打算让诸葛亮去烧曹操的粮草？”
    周瑜说：“他能烧，就最好。不能烧，被曹操杀了，也没关系。”
    鲁肃吃惊极了，不敢相信地问：“你想诸葛亮死？”
    周瑜看着鲁肃，没有回答。
    鲁肃又急又气，马上去找诸葛亮。诸葛亮带着一些兵，正准备去烧曹操的粮草。鲁肃着急地说：“诸葛先生，太危险了，还是让别人去吧！”
    诸葛亮说：“如果我不去，那谁去呢？周将军只会打水仗，离开水，他就不会打仗了，所以还是我去吧。”
    鲁肃又着急地回去见周瑜，把诸葛亮的话告诉了周瑜。周瑜听了很生气：“谁说我只会打水仗？不用诸葛亮，现在我就带人去烧曹操的粮草！”
    鲁肃没办法，马上又把周瑜的话告诉了诸葛亮。诸葛亮笑着说：“周将军让我去烧曹操的粮草，是想让曹操杀我。曹操打仗最喜欢烧别人的粮草，他怎么会不保护好自己的粮草呢？所以曹操一定早就准备好了，不管谁去，都找不到曹操的粮草，而且还会被曹操杀掉。你快回去告诉周将军，让他也不要去了。现在江东已经决定和曹操打仗了，那我们就应该一条心，好好准备打仗。”
    鲁肃吃惊得说不出话，原来周瑜的想法诸葛亮都知道。他马上回去见周瑜，周瑜听了也很吃惊，诸葛亮真的和别人不一样啊！他是个很特别的人。
fullText.traditional:
第2章、燒糧草

    馬上就要打仗了，周瑜經常到江邊來看一看，每次看完他都不說話。魯肅問他在想什麼，他也不說話。魯肅就來問諸葛亮，諸葛亮笑著說：“放心吧，周將軍心裡有安排，魯大人不用擔心。”
    諸葛亮說這樣的話，讓人覺得他好像很了解周瑜，就像他是周瑜的老朋友。周瑜聽到這些話，有點兒高興，也有點兒不高興。高興的是很少有人這麼了解自己，不高興的是他不希望自己的計劃被人看出來，更不希望這個人就是諸葛亮。因為諸葛亮是劉備的人，不但不能做朋友，而且還不能太聰明。
    周瑜請諸葛亮來家裡喝茶。喝茶的時候，他對諸葛亮說：“曹操的軍隊每天都要吃飯，戰馬每天都要吃草。如果沒有糧和草，曹操就不能打仗了，所以我想請你帶兵去燒曹操的糧草，你能做到嗎？”
    諸葛亮笑著說：“沒問題。”他喝了口茶，就回去準備了。
    魯肅聽說了，馬上來問周瑜：“你真的打算讓諸葛亮去燒曹操的糧草？”
    周瑜說：“他能燒，就最好。不能燒，被曹操殺了，也沒關係。”
    魯肅吃驚極了，不敢相信地問：“你想諸葛亮死？”
    周瑜看著魯肅，沒有回答。
    魯肅又急又氣，馬上去找諸葛亮。諸葛亮帶著一些兵，正準備去燒曹操的糧草。魯肅著急地說：“諸葛先生，太危險了，還是讓別人去吧！”
    諸葛亮說：“如果我不去，那誰去呢？周將軍只會打水仗，離開水，他就不會打仗了，所以還是我去吧。”
    魯肅又著急地回去見周瑜，把諸葛亮的話告訴了周瑜。周瑜聽了很生氣：“誰說我只會打水仗？不用諸葛亮，現在我就帶人去燒曹操的糧草！”
    魯肅沒辦法，馬上又把周瑜的話告訴了諸葛亮。諸葛亮笑著說：“周將軍讓我去燒曹操的糧草，是想讓曹操殺我。曹操打仗最喜歡燒別人的糧草，他怎麼會不保護好自己的糧草呢？所以曹操一定早就準備好了，不管誰去，都找不到曹操的糧草，而且還會被曹操殺掉。你快回去告訴周將軍，讓他也不要去了。現在江東已經決定和曹操打仗了，那我們就應該一條心，好好準備打仗。”
    魯肅吃驚得說不出話，原來周瑜的想法諸葛亮都知道。他馬上回去見周瑜，周瑜聽了也很吃驚，諸葛亮真的和別人不一樣啊！他是個很特別的人。

sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ cáo cāo yí dìng zǎo jiù zhǔn bèi hǎo le
sentences.english: So Cao Cao must have prepared it in advance.

sentences.simplified: 不管谁去，都找不到曹操的粮草，而且还会被曹操杀掉。
sentences.traditional: 不管誰去，都找不到曹操的糧草，而且還會被曹操殺掉。
sentences.pinyin: bù guǎn shéi qù dōu zhǎo bú dào cáo cāo de liáng cǎo ér qiě hái huì bèi cáo cāo shā diào
sentences.english: Regardless of who goes, they won’t be able to find Cao Cao’s rations and fodder, and they will be killed by Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 你快回去告诉周将军，让他也不要去了。
sentences.traditional: 你快回去告訴周將軍，讓他也不要去了。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ kuài huí qù gào su zhōu jiāng jūn ràng tā yě bú yào qù le
sentences.english: Quickly go back to tell General Zhou and stop him from going.

sentences.simplified: 现在江东已经决定和曹操打仗了，那我们就应该一条心，好好准备打仗。”
sentences.traditional: 現在江東已經決定和曹操打仗了，那我們就應該一條心，好好準備打仗。”
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài jiāng dōng yǐ jīng jué dìng hé cáo cāo dǎ zhàng le nà wǒ men jiù yīng gāi yì tiáo xīn hǎo hǎo zhǔn bèi dǎ zhàng
sentences.english: Right now, Jiangdong has decided to fight Cao Cao, so we should be united and prepare well for this battle.

sentences.simplified: 鲁肃吃惊得说不出话，原来周瑜的想法诸葛亮都知道。
sentences.traditional: 魯肅吃驚得說不出話，原來周瑜的想法諸葛亮都知道。
sentences.pinyin: lǔ sù chī jīng de shuō bù chū huà yuán lái zhōu yú de xiǎng fǎ zhū gě liàng dōu zhī dào
sentences.english: Lu Su was too taken aback to speak. It turned out that Zhuge Liang already knew what Zhou Yu was thinking.

sentences.simplified: 他马上回去见周瑜，周瑜听了也很吃惊，诸葛亮真的和别人不一样啊！
sentences.traditional: 他馬上回去見周瑜，周瑜聽了也很吃驚，諸葛亮真的和別人不一樣啊！
sentences.pinyin: tā mǎ shàng huí qù jiàn zhōu yú zhōu yú tīng le yě hěn chī jīng zhū gě liàng zhēn de hé bié ren bù yí yàng a
sentences.english: He immediately left to see Zhou Yu. After Zhou Yu heard, he was also very taken aback. Zhuge Liang really was not like other people!

sentences.simplified: 他是个很特别的人。
sentences.traditional: 他是個很特別的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì ge hěn tè bié de rén
sentences.english: He was a very special person.

sentence_translations: Chapter 2: Burning Rations and Fodder
The battle was about to start. Zhou Yu often came to the bank of the river to watch, and each time, he didn’t say anything.
Lu Su asked him what he was thinking about, and he also didn’t say anything.
Lu Su came to ask Zhuge Liang. Zhuge Liang smiled and said, ..
.. “Relax, General Zhou has a plan in mind. There’s no need to worry, Lord Lu.”
When Zhuge Liang said this, it made people think that he really understood Zhou Yu, as if he was Zhou Yu’s old friend.
Zhou Yu heard these words. He felt a little happy and also felt a little unhappy.
He was happy as very few people understood him so well.
He was unhappy as he didn’t want anyone to discover his plan, especially if that person was Zhuge Liang.
Because Zhuge Liang was under Liu Bei, not only could they not be friends, but he also should not be too intelligent.
Zhou Yu invited Zhuge Liang to his home to drink tea.
As they were drinking tea, he said to Zhuge Liang, ..
.. “Cao Cao’s troops need to eat food every day, and his war horses have to eat fodder every day.
If they don’t have rations and fodder, Cao Cao can’t fight anymore.
So I want to ask you to take soldiers to burn Cao Cao’s rations and fodder. Can you do this?”
Zhuge Liang smiled and said, “No problem.” He took a sip of tea and left to prepare.
Lu Su heard of this and immediately came to ask Zhou Yu, “Do you really plan to make Zhuge Liang go and burn Cao Cao’s rations and fodder?”
Zhou Yu said, “If he can, that would be best. If he can’t, and he gets killed by Cao Cao, that is also not a problem.”
Lu Su was very taken aback. He asked in disbelief, “You want Zhuge Liang to die?”
Zhou Yu looked at Lu Su and did not answer.
Lu Su was worried and angry and immediately went to see Zhuge Liang.
Zhuge Liang led some soldiers and was preparing to go and burn Cao Cao’s rations and fodder.
Lu Su anxiously said, “Mr. Zhuge, it is too dangerous. You should make someone else go!”
Zhuge Liang said, “If I don’t go, then who will?
General Zhou can only fight naval battles. He can’t fight away from the water. So, I should go.
Lu Su anxiously went back to see Zhou Yu again and told Zhou Yu what Zhuge Liang had said.
Zhou Yu heard this and became very angry: “Who says I can only fight naval battles?
We don’t need Zhuge Liang. I will take men to burn Cao Cao’s rations and fodder right now!”
Lu Su had no choice. He immediately told Zhuge Liang what Zhou Yu had said.
Zhuge Liang laughed and said, “General Zhou got me to go and burn Cao Cao’s rations and fodder because he wanted to make Cao Cao kill me.
When Cao Cao fights battles, he loves to burn other people’s rations and fodder. How would he not protect his own rations and fodder?
So Cao Cao must have prepared it in advance.
Regardless of who goes, they won’t be able to find Cao Cao’s rations and fodder, and they will be killed by Cao Cao.
Quickly go back to tell General Zhou and stop him from going.
Right now, Jiangdong has decided to fight Cao Cao, so we should be united and prepare well for this battle.
Lu Su was too taken aback to speak. It turned out that Zhuge Liang already knew what Zhou Yu was thinking.
He immediately left to see Zhou Yu. After Zhou Yu heard, he was also very taken aback. Zhuge Liang really was not like other people!
He was a very special person.
